name: hmd-app-neuronsphere-core
description: Core of the NeuronSphere deployment GUI: environments, BOMs, ChangeSet drafting and validation, repo classes, the resource catalogue and discovery -- everything that works against the registry-and-resolver core of the deployment service. The premium overlay (hmd-app-neuronsphere) layers run observability and apply on top of this image.

discovery.summary: Core NeuronSphere deployment GUI (Django + HTMX), the half of the NERD0015 split that nsctl runs locally. Serves environments, BOMs, ChangeSet drafting/validation/compare, repo classes and versions, the resource catalogue and discovery search, plus the MCP server, against the deployment service's core routes. Ships an extension seam -- DJANGO_EXTRA_APPS, DEPLOYMENT_API_CLIENT_CLASS, {% extension_slot %} -- through which the premium image (hmd-app-neuronsphere, FROM this one) adds the ChangeSetDeployment list, timeline, DAG, logs and apply.

entry_points.description: Django management entry point for running and serving the application.
Shared Django settings: allauth/Okta OIDC provider, installed apps, and optional django-redis caching (falls back to LocMemCache).
Project root URL routing for the deployment_gui Django project.
Main app views: BOM DAG, repo class version detail, ChangeSet views/diffs, environments, deployment sets, instances, and the health check.
App URL routes mapping request paths to the deployments views.
ASGI entry point: routes /mcp to the FastMCP server and everything else to Django.
Builds the MCP server: auth provider, tool registration, federation seam.
The extension seam: where premium apps render into core pages.

capabilities.name: /health/
capabilities.description: Health check endpoint returning application liveness status.

capabilities.name: require_environment_access
capabilities.description: Decorator enforcing per-environment RBAC by resolving the caller's Okta group -> environment role mapping.

capabilities.name: require_deployment_set_access
capabilities.description: Decorator enforcing RBAC on deployment-set scoped views.

capabilities.name: OktaTokenExpiryMiddleware
capabilities.description: Middleware that redirects users to Okta re-login when their access token has expired.

capabilities.name: DeploymentAPIClient
capabilities.description: Client for the hmd-ms-deployment microservice; forwards the user's Okta access token on each backend call.

capabilities.name: get_api_client_for_request
capabilities.description: Per-request factory building an authenticated DeploymentAPIClient from the current request's Okta token.

capabilities.name: /mcp
capabilities.description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP. Authenticates with a platform API key (Okta bearer in Phase 3), authorizes every environment-scoped tool against UserEnvironmentPermission, and audits each call.

capabilities.name: list_environments
capabilities.description: MCP tool: environments the caller may read, with their role on each.

capabilities.name: MCPApiKey
capabilities.description: Bearer credential for the MCP server, bound to a Django user; only the SHA-256 hash is stored.

capabilities.name: create_mcp_api_key
capabilities.description: Management command that mints an MCP API key and prints it once.

capabilities.name: describe_environment
capabilities.description: MCP tool: what is deployed in an environment -- counts and filter facets at detail='summary', the paginated instance list at detail='full'.

capabilities.name: describe_instance
capabilities.description: MCP tool: one instance's metadata, effective merged configuration, dependency wiring tagged by kind, and recent deployment history.

capabilities.name: get_instance_dependencies
capabilities.description: MCP tool: an instance's dependency edges in either direction; one BOM read, no role classification.

capabilities.name: find_resource_providers
capabilities.description: MCP tool: which repo classes can produce a resource definition, with its isa ancestry and effective output schema. Platform-wide catalog query, not environment-scoped.

capabilities.name: get_instance_configuration
capabilities.description: MCP tool: the effective deployed configuration of one instance, with a dotted-path projection and a keys-only outline for probing a large config cheaply.

capabilities.name: search_repo_classes
capabilities.description: MCP tool: search the platform-wide repo class catalog by name or repo type.

capabilities.name: describe_repo_class
capabilities.description: MCP tool: a repo class's versions, or one version's discovery metadata, declared dependency roles, and default configuration.

capabilities.name: list_resource_definitions
capabilities.description: MCP tool: the resource definition catalog -- the namespaced, versioned types dependency roles are declared against.

capabilities.name: find_resource_candidates
capabilities.description: MCP tool: what is already deployed in one environment that could satisfy a resource dependency role.

capabilities.name: compare_environments
capabilities.description: MCP tool: how two environments have diverged; authorizes view access to both.

capabilities.name: extension_slot
capabilities.description: Template tag rendering <app>/slots/<name>.html from every settings.EXTRA_APPS app, with the app's slots.context(request).
